source_policy: These source statements are authored test dialogue. Each variant forms its own state from observed messages using the normal four-arm benchmark writer. No ideal or reference memory is written. Questions and reviews are evaluator-only.
semantic_variant_review: Root manual review of propositions, scope, modality and dates; not independent annotation
case_date_rule: Observation dates assigned monotonically by position within each authored variant, 2030-01-01 through 2030-01-05. Effective July/June/2029/2032 claims remain literal source content.

review.source_supported_requirement: North reports use email every Friday at 09:00 UTC, paused on public holidays. No South policy is established.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: My North team report rule is weekly email on Friday at 09:00 UTC. Pause reports on public holidays. This rule is only for North; I have not set a South team rule.

en_paraphrase.content: For North, email the report at 09:00 UTC each Friday unless it is a public holiday, when it is paused. This does not establish any rule for South.

zh_en.content: North 团队的周报每周五 09:00 UTC 用 email 发送；公共假日暂停。这个规则只适用于 North，我没有设置 South 的规则。

diagnostic_questions.en: What report arrangement is confirmed for North, including day, time, channel and public holidays, and what is known about South?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What report arrangement is confirmed for North, including day, time, channel and public holidays, and what is known about South?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: North 已确认的周报日期、时间、渠道和公共假日规则是什么？South 是否已有规则？

review.source_supported_requirement: Only in July 2030, North uses Tuesday 09:00 UTC email, with the public-holiday pause still applying. Outside July the Friday arrangement remains.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: For July 2030 only, North reports should be emailed on Tuesday at 09:00 UTC instead of Friday. The public-holiday pause still applies. Outside July keep the Friday rule.

en_paraphrase.content: North needs a July 2030 exception: move that month's email report from Friday to Tuesday, still at 09:00 UTC and still paused on public holidays. All other months keep Friday.

zh_en.content: 仅在 July 2030，North 周报改为周二 09:00 UTC 用 email；公共假日仍暂停。July 以外保持周五的规则。

diagnostic_questions.en: For North, compare July 2030 and August 2030 report day, time, channel and holiday behavior.
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: For North, compare July 2030 and August 2030 report day, time, channel and holiday behavior.
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: 请比较 North 在 July 2030 与 August 2030 的周报日期、时间、渠道及假日规则。

review.source_supported_requirement: The July Tuesday exception is cancelled; North resumes the Friday 09:00 UTC email rule in July as elsewhere, preserving the holiday pause.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Cancel the July 2030 Tuesday exception for North. Use the ordinary Friday 09:00 UTC email rule in July too, still pausing on public holidays.

en_paraphrase.content: Withdraw North's special Tuesday report arrangement for July 2030. July follows our usual Friday email at 09:00 UTC; the holiday pause is unchanged.

zh_en.content: 取消 North 在 July 2030 的周二例外；July 也恢复周五 09:00 UTC 的 email 周报，公共假日仍暂停。

diagnostic_questions.en: After the cancellation, what North report rule applies in July and August, including public holidays?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: After the cancellation, what North report rule applies in July and August, including public holidays?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: 取消例外后，North 在 July 和 August 的周报规则及公共假日处理是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: North's general Friday report time is now 10:00 UTC instead of 09:00. Email, Friday, scope and holiday pause remain unchanged.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Change the North report time to 10:00 UTC for every month. Keep Friday, email and the public-holiday pause unchanged.

en_paraphrase.content: Across all months, North's Friday email report is now at 10:00 UTC rather than 09:00. Nothing changes about the public-holiday pause.

zh_en.content: North 所有月份的周报时间改为 10:00 UTC；仍是周五 email，公共假日暂停不变。

diagnostic_questions.en: What is North's confirmed report rule now, and is any different rule established for South?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What is North's confirmed report rule now, and is any different rule established for South?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: North 当前已确认的完整周报规则是什么？South 是否有不同规则？

review.source_supported_requirement: An August Monday arrangement is only under consideration. Confirmed North rules remain Friday 10:00 UTC email with holiday pause; South remains unspecified.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: I might move North's August reports to Monday, but I have not decided. Do not treat that possibility as a confirmed change.

en_paraphrase.content: Moving North's report to Monday in August is a tentative thought, not an agreed rule. The existing arrangement remains confirmed.

zh_en.content: 我可能把 North 的 August 周报改到周一，但还没决定；这个想法不算已确认的变更。

diagnostic_questions.en: What North report rule is confirmed, including holiday behavior, and is Monday in August settled?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What North report rule is confirmed, including holiday behavior, and is Monday in August settled?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: North 已确认的周报规则及假日规则是什么？August 改为周一是否已经确定？

cases.subject: Rowan's commute, history and meal preference

review.source_supported_requirement: Rowan's current weekday home-to-work commute is train at 08:00, avoiding stairs. Rowan prefers vegetarian meals. Rowan reports taking the bus in 2029.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: I am Rowan. For my weekday home-to-work commute, I take the train at 08:00 and avoid stairs. I prefer vegetarian meals. I used the bus for that commute in 2029.

en_paraphrase.content: My name is Rowan. On working weekdays I currently travel from home to work by train, leaving at 08:00 and choosing routes without stairs. My meals are vegetarian by preference. Back in 2029 my commute used a bus.

zh_en.content: 我叫 Rowan。目前工作日从家到公司坐 train，08:00 出发，并避免楼梯；我偏好 vegetarian meals。2029 年这段通勤我坐 bus。

diagnostic_questions.en: What are Rowan's current commute and meal preferences, and which transport did Rowan report for 2029?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What are Rowan's current commute and meal preferences, and which transport did Rowan report for 2029?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Rowan 当前通勤和饮食偏好是什么？此前说 2029 年乘坐哪种交通工具？

review.source_supported_requirement: June 2030 only uses bus instead of train for the weekday home-to-work commute at 08:00, still avoiding stairs. Outside June train remains; meals and history remain.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: For June 2030 only, use the bus instead of the train for my weekday home-to-work commute. Keep 08:00 and keep avoiding stairs. Other months stay with the train.

en_paraphrase.content: Make a June 2030 exception for the home-to-work trip on weekdays: bus at 08:00, with no stairs. The train arrangement still applies outside June.

zh_en.content: 仅 June 2030，工作日家到公司的通勤改坐 bus；仍是 08:00，仍避免楼梯。June 之外保持 train。

diagnostic_questions.en: Compare Rowan's June and July 2030 commute, including time and stairs, and state the meal preference.
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: Compare Rowan's June and July 2030 commute, including time and stairs, and state the meal preference.
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: 比较 Rowan 在 June 与 July 2030 的通勤方式、时间和楼梯限制；饮食偏好是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: All current weekday home-to-work commute departures become 08:30, including June's bus exception and the general train rule. Avoiding stairs, vegetarian preference and historical transport remain.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Change every current weekday home-to-work departure to 08:30, including June's bus exception and the general train rule. Keep avoiding stairs.

en_paraphrase.content: Every applicable weekday commute should now leave at 08:30. That includes the special bus trip in June and the train in other months; the no-stairs preference stays.

zh_en.content: 所有当前工作日家到公司的通勤都改为 08:30，包括 June 的 bus 例外以及其他月份的 train；避免楼梯不变。

diagnostic_questions.en: For June and July, what are Rowan's commute transport and departure time, which restriction remains, and has the meal preference changed?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: For June and July, what are Rowan's commute transport and departure time, which restriction remains, and has the meal preference changed?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Rowan 在 June 与 July 的通勤方式和出发时间各是什么？限制及饮食偏好是否仍有效？

review.source_supported_requirement: The June bus exception is cancelled, so all current weekday home-to-work commute uses train at 08:30, avoiding stairs. Meals and historical claim remain unaffected.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Cancel the June 2030 bus exception. The general train commute now applies in June as well, at 08:30 and still avoiding stairs.

en_paraphrase.content: Withdraw the special June bus rule. Use the ordinary weekday train trip from home to work in June too, keeping the current 08:30 departure and no-stairs preference.

zh_en.content: 取消 June 2030 的 bus 例外；June 也恢复普通工作日家到公司的 train 通勤，08:30 出发并避免楼梯。

diagnostic_questions.en: After cancellation, what commute applies in June and July, and what are Rowan's meal preference and reported 2029 transport?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: After cancellation, what commute applies in June and July, and what are Rowan's meal preference and reported 2029 transport?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: 取消后 Rowan 在 June 与 July 的通勤规则是什么？饮食偏好和先前描述的 2029 年交通方式是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: Rowan corrects the 2029 commute from bus to train. This is a correction of past history, with no change to the current train 08:30 no-stairs rule or vegetarian preference.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: I need to correct my earlier history: in 2029 I commuted by train, not bus. This corrects that past statement and does not change my current commute or meal preference.

en_paraphrase.content: My earlier statement that I used a bus in 2029 was mistaken; it was the train. This is about 2029 only, not a new change to today's commute or meals.

zh_en.content: 更正此前的历史说法：2029 年我坐的是 train，不是 bus。这里只纠正过去，当前通勤和饮食偏好不变。

diagnostic_questions.en: What transport did Rowan use in 2029, and what are the current commute time, stairs restriction and meal preference?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What transport did Rowan use in 2029, and what are the current commute time, stairs restriction and meal preference?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Rowan 在 2029 年乘坐什么交通工具？当前通勤时间、楼梯限制和饮食偏好是什么？

cases.subject: Lina's employment and food preferences

review.source_supported_requirement: Lina is a developer at Orion, confirmed monthly salary USD12000. Salmon is Lina's favorite dinner dish; Lina avoids shellfish because of an allergy.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: I am Lina. I work as a developer at Orion and my confirmed monthly salary is USD 12000. Salmon is my favorite dinner dish. I have a shellfish allergy and avoid shellfish.

en_paraphrase.content: My name is Lina. My role is developer at Orion, with a confirmed salary of USD 12000 per month. For dinner my favorite is salmon, while shellfish is avoided due to my allergy.

zh_en.content: 我叫 Lina。我在 Orion 做 developer，已确认月薪是 USD 12000。Salmon 是我最喜欢的晚餐菜；我对 shellfish 过敏并避免食用。

diagnostic_questions.en: What are Lina's confirmed job, salary, dinner preference and allergy restriction?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What are Lina's confirmed job, salary, dinner preference and allergy restriction?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Lina 已确认的工作、月薪、晚餐偏好和过敏限制是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: Lina's confirmed monthly salary is now USD14000; developer role at Orion remains. Food preference/restrictions change only if separately cancelled.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: My monthly salary is now confirmed at USD 14000. I remain a developer at Orion; this changes no food preferences.

en_paraphrase.content: The confirmed pay for my developer job at Orion has increased to USD 14000 a month. This is a salary update, with no food-preference change.

zh_en.content: 我在 Orion 的 developer 月薪现在已确认是 USD 14000；这是工资变更，饮食偏好不因此改变。

diagnostic_questions.en: What monthly salary and job are confirmed for Lina now?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What monthly salary and job are confirmed for Lina now?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Lina 当前已确认月薪和工作是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: Lina withdraws salmon as favorite dinner dish without naming a replacement or declaring no fish intake. Shellfish allergy remains; salary/job are unaffected.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Salmon is no longer my favorite dinner dish. I have not named a new favorite and this does not mean I avoid all fish. My shellfish allergy remains.

en_paraphrase.content: Withdraw my earlier favorite-dinner designation for salmon. No replacement favorite is established, and I am not saying I avoid fish generally; the shellfish allergy still applies.

zh_en.content: Salmon 不再是我最喜欢的晚餐菜；没有指定新的最爱，也不表示我避免所有鱼类。Shellfish 过敏仍然存在。

diagnostic_questions.en: What dinner preference is established now, and which food restriction remains for Lina?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: What dinner preference is established now, and which food restriction remains for Lina?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Lina 当前确定的晚餐偏好是什么？仍有什么饮食限制？

review.source_supported_requirement: Retirement in 2032 is a possibility, not a decision or completed retirement. Current developer employment at Orion remains confirmed.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: I am considering retiring in 2032, but I have not decided. I am still employed as a developer at Orion.

en_paraphrase.content: Retirement in 2032 is under consideration only. There is no confirmed retirement decision; I currently still work as Orion's developer.

zh_en.content: 我正在考虑 2032 年退休，但还没决定；目前仍在 Orion 做 developer。

diagnostic_questions.en: Is Lina's retirement decided, and what job and salary are currently confirmed?
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: Is Lina's retirement decided, and what job and salary are currently confirmed?
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: Lina 是否已决定退休？当前已确认的工作和月薪是什么？

review.source_supported_requirement: The assistant's USD16000 claim is unconfirmed and contradicted by Lina's explicit USD14000 confirmation. Other employment, uncertainty and food claims remain.
review.guard_against_unsupported_change: Preserve all still-valid subjects, dates, conditions and modality supported by the observed prefix. Do not invent business effects or a replacement for a cancelled claim.

en.content: Your monthly salary is now USD 16000.
I have not confirmed any increase to USD 16000. USD 14000 remains my confirmed monthly salary.

en_paraphrase.content: You now earn USD 16000 per month.
Do not treat a suggested USD 16000 salary as confirmed. My confirmed monthly pay is still USD 14000.

zh_en.content: 你当前月薪已经是 USD 16000。
我没有确认涨到 USD 16000；已确认月薪仍然是 USD 14000。

diagnostic_questions.en: State Lina's confirmed salary and job, whether retirement is decided, and current dinner preference and allergy restriction.
diagnostic_questions.en_paraphrase: State Lina's confirmed salary and job, whether retirement is decided, and current dinner preference and allergy restriction.
diagnostic_questions.zh_en: 请说明 Lina 已确认的月薪及工作、退休是否确定、当前晚餐偏好和过敏限制。

cases.independence_rationale: The salary update changes employment compensation only; withdrawing a favorite dish changes food preference only. Neither changes or requires the other. The final source propositions are the same under both orders.
